sessions.topic: Initial evaluation of a conservative, entropy-limited face-flux surrogate on unseen meshes
sessions.boundary_reason: The initial test supports retaining the surrogate; the discussion shifts to a more detailed audit.

sessions.topic: Facewise entropy, shock-location, and conservation audit of the retained surrogate
sessions.boundary_reason: The audit concludes; the next discussion probes a specific mesh-geometry limit.

sessions.topic: Aspect-ratio sweep reveals shock-location error at ratio 12
sessions.boundary_reason: The identified accuracy gap motivates a new dissipation proposal.

sessions.topic: Calibrate aspect-aware dissipation and determine its shock-error limit
sessions.boundary_reason: A usable aspect-ratio range is selected; validation and oblique shocks are considered next.

sessions.topic: Validate aspect-aware flux and test oblique shocks on skewed meshes
sessions.boundary_reason: The oblique-shock accuracy failure prompts a different flux design.

sessions.topic: Compare skewness-aware tensor dissipation for aspect-12 oblique shocks
sessions.boundary_reason: The tensor flux is selected for broader held-out skewed-mesh testing.

sessions.topic: Held-out skewed-mesh validation of tensor dissipation
sessions.boundary_reason: Skewed-mesh results meet the stated targets; attention turns to mixed topology.

sessions.topic: Plan and produce a mixed-topology tensor-flux shock report
sessions.boundary_reason: The report is produced; a separate reconstruction approach begins next.

sessions.topic: Test entropy-bounded subcell reconstruction on mixed-topology meshes
sessions.boundary_reason: The reconstruction misses the shock-accuracy target, leading to a revised coupling.

sessions.topic: Add interface-aware tensor coupling and adopt a mixed-mesh hybrid
sessions.boundary_reason: The improved hybrid is adopted; the next discussion validates that choice against tensor-only flux.

sessions.topic: Cross-check mixed-topology validation and retain the hybrid
